meaning:
δι-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for בּתר (as Gen.15:10), חלק (as Jos.18:5), etc. ;]
1. to divide into parts, cut asunder.
2. to distribute: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), Luk.15:12, 1Co.12:11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ He divided his livelihood between them.
But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
